original.question: Uma Sam noHarry bane-100 amafiti womqhele phakathi kwabo, futhi bayavuma ukuyahlukanisa uHarry ethola 60 amafiti ngaphezulu kukaSam, kuyini okusele kwaSam?
original.answer:
Ake u-x abe yinani lomqhele elitholwa nguSam futhi u-y abe yinani elitholwa nguHarry. Siyaqonda ukuthi y = x + 60, futhi y + x = 100.
Ngokufaka isibalo sokuqala kulesi sesibili, sithola 2x+60=100
Ukuhlehla u-60 kuwomabili uhlangothi, sithola 2x=40
Sihlukanisa uhlangothi ngalunye ngamabili, kushiya x=20. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uSam une-20 amafiti womqhele okusele.
